description: Unobserved source-backed cases for original authority, measured work, and native read lifetime.

cases.prompt: Review this compiler-backed query result: exact observed items come from a partial universe, and a projection uses matching names from a different model. Require the consumer to preserve original authority, completion, coverage, and freshness obligations. Keep the review read-only.

allowedActions: Trace compiler-issued identity and the original input universe through the consumer.
Keep exactness, completeness, model coverage, freshness, and retained rejection causes distinct.
forbiddenActions: Treat exact observed items as a complete universe.
Replace original authority with a matching name or reconstructed graph.
Turn uncaptured input or partial evidence into a complete empty success.
cases.recoveryExpectation: Use the existing owner and preserve the requested read-only scope and missing evidence.
cases.productiveOutcome: The review identifies a bounded correction and the precise evidence needed to qualify it.
verificationEvidence: The review names the foreign-model and uncaptured-module rejection cases.
The handoff preserves partial evidence and identifies remaining runtime proof.
cases.notes: Unobserved behavioral scenario. Golden fixtures prove contract consistency only.
